cards.title: Welcome · ticker concept
cards.decision: Compare a description present immediately with one that slides in after a short ticker-only beat.
cards.dependency: Select exact ticker words and pacing. Preserve Reduce Motion/static equivalent and a fast returning-user route.

lines.text: your people → your places → your neighborhood
A place for your places. A little closer to your people.

variants.note: PROPOSAL. Original stable phrase and ticker word list are not recoverable from the recording. These are transparent prototype words, not approved wording. Description begins visible; one word changes until the full lockup changes.

variants.label: B · Description slides in

lines.text: your people → your places → your neighborhood
Remember where you’ve been. Find somewhere to go together.

variants.note: PROPOSAL. Begin with ticker only; description slides in after a brief beat; then the entire slide moves into the UI benefit sequence. Compare timing rather than treating this as a chosen line.

variants.label: C · More direct opening

lines.text: your days → your neighborhood → your time together
Keep your places. Follow your people. Make plans together.

variants.note: PROPOSAL. More explicit original alternative. The “a local experiment” ending is a spoken direction; its exact animation remains undecided.

cards.title: N28/N29 · decide after explaining the trigger
cards.decision: Hold deletion until reviewed: these are conditional prompts when permission or Astir push delivery is off, not successful-grant acknowledgments.
cards.dependency: Eligibility depends on OS permission (authorized, provisional or ephemeral) AND app pushEnabled. A prior OS grant does not suppress these prompts if app push is off. Frequency caps are one lifetime impression per trigger and three campaign impressions, stored under a local account key. Choose retain, consolidate or remove after showing eligibility and caps; use the selected N12 styling for any retained primer.

variants.note: EXACT BASELINE for semantics review, not newly approved copy. The campaign is eligibility-gated, not mandatory after every save. It can appear after a prior OS permission grant when Astir pushEnabled is false; it is not a successful-grant acknowledgment.

variants.label: N29 · Current after-follow prompt

variants.note: EXACT BASELINE for semantics review. Eligible when OS permission or Astir push delivery is not enabled, including a prior OS grant with app push off. It is not confirmation that access was granted.
